thread:
sara: Hey team — Lumina Health just sent the full SIG. Procurement wants controls mapping + artifacts. I kicked off a gap list in the spreadsheet. Top open items: Q3.2 KMS rotation, Q4.1 data residency options, Q6.5 latest pen test. Can SEs/AMs help stitch artifacts?

mike: On it. I can pull KMS config and rotation policy. Where should I drop the files?

jess: Made a share: https://drive.redwood.ai/luminara-sig (read/write for this thread). I dropped our SOC2 cert and network diagram already. See my comment on Q2.1 (SSO flow).

tom: Note: customer asked for BYOK requirement in Private deploys. That's supported but we need the contract clause. I added a short note in the drive about BYOK + HSM options.

sig-bot: Automated reminder: SIG item "Pen test report (v2024-11)" is missing. Please attach or provide redacted copy. Deadline requested by customer: 2025-01-20.

mike: Uploaded a redacted pen test here: https://drive.redwood.ai/luminara-sig/pen-test-redacted.pdf (removed IPs/targets). Let me know if this is sufficient.

sara: Perfect — thanks. For Q4.1 (data residency) we need a short statement confirming EU-region deployment + contract clause. @legal to confirm SLA language.

jess: For KMS (Q3.2) I added the example we give customers: ```bash
# create customer key example
aws kms create-key --description "Redwood customer key" --policy file://policy.json
# recommended rotation cadence
aws kms enable-key-rotation --key-id 1234abcd --rotation-period 90
```

tom: Added a console screenshot showing the KMS toggle and sample key policy in Drive under /screenshots. Also dropped a short BYOK integration note for Lumina's infra team.

mike: Drafted a customer-facing attestation for the pen test and attached it: https://drive.redwood.ai/luminara-sig/attestation-draft.docx. Need legal review before sending.

sara: @tom @jess quick: Q7.3 asks about access revocation for ex-employees. Could you paste the minimal steps we should give them?

tom: Short answer: Okta SCIM provisioning + auto-revoke tokens on deprovision. Runbook steps: 1) disable Okta user 2) API revoke tokens 3) disable service accounts 4) audit last login. Snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"user_id":"{{uid}}"}'
```

jess: I filled Q7.3 in the spreadsheet and linked the runbook + a demo short video. Also updated Q9.2 with current subprocessor list (GCP EU, Azure US, Sentry for errors).

sara: Great — I'll go row-by-row in the spreadsheet tomorrow morning and mark items as "provided" or "needs legal". Can folks aim to resolve the flagged gap list by EOD tomorrow? :pray:

mike: Yea I can finish redaction notes and confirm the pen test attestation by EOD.

tom: I'll ping legal on the BYOK clause and upload the signed snippet if they approve.

jess: I'll tidy the SSO diagram and add a short note about SCIM provisioning status.

sara: Thanks everyone — once the spreadsheet is green I'll send the compiled package to Lumina procurement and copy the customer success lead.

sara: Marking this thread as active until the package is sent. Will update last message when complete. :white_check_mark:
